impact: Two-part failure. Part 1 (harness): The cadence gate computes its target from `fps_num/fps_den = 0/1 = 0fps` (PipeWire variable-rate capture). Any non-zero observed fps fails this gate. Fix: handle fps_num=0 in validation/drivers.ts — either skip the cadence gate or use a separately configured target fps. Part 2 (workload mismatch, see ISS-003): Even if the harness target is fixed to 60fps, this run observed ~105fps from a 4K (3840×2160) capture, not 1080p60. Fixing ISS-001 alone is insufficient to unblock VAL-CAP-004 — ISS-003 must also be resolved. Blocks T-021 green verdict and T-010c gate.
title: VAL-CAP-004 cadence gate fails against fps_num=0 (variable-rate PipeWire capture)
